examples.arabic: أحمد قال لصاحبه علي: الجو هنا جميل أوي النهاردة.
examples.english: Ahmed said to his friend Ali: The atmosphere here is very beautiful today.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed al le sahbo Ali: El gaw hena gamil awi ennaharda.

examples.arabic: العيلة كلهم كويسين واخواتي كانوا هنا امبارح
examples.english: The family are all well and my siblings were here yesterday.
examples.transliteration: El eila kollohom kwayessin we akhwaty kano hena embareh

examples.arabic: انا مستني صاحبي عشان هو بيشتغل قريب من هنا
examples.english: I am waiting for my friend because he works near here.
examples.transliteration: ana mestanni sahby ashan howa biyeshtaghal oreyeb men hena

examples.arabic: هو قال القميص ده مش من هنا
examples.english: He said this shirt is not from here.
examples.transliteration: Howa aal el amees da mesh men hena

examples.arabic: قولتله انا لسه سايبه الشنطه هنا من ساعه و تعبانه اوي من الشغل
examples.english: I told him I just left the bag here an hour ago and I am very tired from work.
examples.transliteration: oltelo ana lessa sayba el shanta hena men saaha wa taabana awi min el shoghl

examples.arabic: فين التاكسي مفيش تاكسي هنا خالص
examples.english: Where's the taxi There's no taxi here at all
examples.transliteration: Feen el taksi mafeesh taksi hena khalas
